          How the calculators work
          
        
          Times and dates are normalised into a consistent representation, then the requested operation is applied. Results are converted into hours, minutes, seconds, decimal hours and other useful formats.
          
        
          1. Enter the time or date values.
          2. The inputs are normalised.
          3. The difference or operation is computed.
          4. The result is shown in multiple formats.

          Frequently asked questions
          
    
          What is the effective hourly rate?
          The total gross earnings divided by total hours. It differs from your base rate when overtime or double-time is involved.
          
      
          Does it calculate tax?
          Only an estimate based on the flat rate you enter. Real tax calculations depend on your country and circumstances.
